facts.fact: INEGE presented the ninth edition of the national Statistical Yearbook, Anuario Estadistico de Guinea Ecuatorial 2026, on 2026-09-25, covering official demographic, social, economic, financial, environmental and administrative data for the last five years.

note: Supervision tour of ministerial statistical services; no product published and no stated work to draw statistics from administrative records.

facts.fact: INEGE presented the eighth edition of the national statistical yearbook on 2025-10-31, with data to December 2024, compiled from data supplied by ministries and official bodies.

note: Popular compendium of INEGE and other official data for 2020-2024; passages show only contents, no statement that it is compiled from administrative records or vital registration.

facts.fact: INEGE published Hechos Vitales Guinea Ecuatorial 2023, edition no. 1, in October 2024, covering births, deaths, marriages and divorces in 2023.
INEGE published edition no. 1 of Hechos Vitales Guinea Ecuatorial 2023 in October 2024, with chapters on births and deaths for 2023.

note: Committee session report: it only recommends giving ministerial statistical services access to administrative registers and lists a security and justice statistics strategy without saying it draws on records; no published product or work under way on administrative sources is stated.

facts.fact: INEGE presented the ninth national Statistical Yearbook on 2026-09-25, with data to December 2025 compiled from ministerial departments' returns, reporting 20,152 civil servants and 2,731 hires in 2025.

facts.fact: STATAFRIC and Statistics Sweden ran a 16-18 December 2025 workshop with INEGE in Malabo that assessed administrative migration data sources, trained participants, drafted terms of reference for a national migration data working group and set a roadmap.
